firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to securely manage quiz data for students and professors. It leverages path-based ownership for student-specific data and segregated collections for professor-specific data and general quiz information. Authorization Independence is achieved by storing student and professor data separately. All paths use semantic names. Segregation ensures QAPs are met, as listing operations are always scoped to collections with homogenous security needs.

Specifically, `users/{userId}/quiz_attempts/{quizAttemptId}` stores student-created quiz attempts. This enforces that only the user can access and modify their own quiz attempts through rules. Professors are stored separately in `/professors/{professorId}` for professor-specific information. Quiz data is stored in `/quizzes/{quizId}` and questions in `/quizzes/{quizId}/questions/{questionId}`. This structure enables professor to be able to see the progress of all students and to be able to see the overall class data. The separation ensures data is not mixed in collections.
